claim: Reality-informed synthetic automated greenhouse experimentation; no AGC digital-twin or trajectory-validation claim.

model.inheritance: Unchanged coefficients inherit the pinned model, as literature/model assumptions, not AGC-calibrated parameters.

provenance.eave_screen_spans: declared idealized geometry, not dimensions certified from Figure A1

boundary.form: deltaQ=Ueff*A*(Tboundary-Tout); add deltaQ/floor_area to selected air-layer heat-flow numerator
boundary.radiation: retain native lumped approximation; no new wall radiation or storage states
boundary.provenance: fixed synthetic development scenario; no measured boundary calibration

capacity.lamp_source: native Katzin LED efficacy and heat partition retained as a group
capacity.heating_vent_co2_source: AGC2024 capacity references; synthetic configuration, not hardware replay

facility.area_convention: All crop states, LAI, harvest and economic rates use greenhouse floor area. No AGC net-growing-area conversion or integer plant replication.
facility.crop: native simplified Vanthoor tomato; continuous canopy, fixed density regime implicit in native initial states
facility.root_zone: non-limiting supply; no root-zone stress module, irrigation or EC optimisation
facility.screen: Native response curves evaluated by shared sampled controller from available measurements; held cmdScreen for 300s; no agent screen action.
facility.initial_state: At campaign start use pinned native state initials for all copies. Between crops retain climate/facility state; reset crop carbon states and tCanSum to native initials, tCan24 to current tAir and tCan to current tAir. Zero-crop idle mode must be implemented and checked in Phase 1.

central_supply.interpretation: Explicit synthetic adequacy assumption: four independently capped units may all request full output simultaneously. Minimum adequacy is not measured central equipment rating. No central bottleneck or pro-rata allocator in main environment.
central_supply.provenance: User-approved Phase 1 design choice 2026-09-27; per-unit maxima from v2 model contract.

policy.range_provenance: development design bounds; must pass Phase 1 numerical/domain checks, not agronomic optimum claims

controller.timezone: fixed site local standard time, no DST
controller.lamp_rule: 06:00 <= local_hour < 06:00+supplemental_light_hours, current available iGlob <400 W/m2, and available air temperature <35 C; all other times off
controller.day_night_rule: fixed clock interval, independent of future solar radiation or lamp switching
controller.co2_rule: native proportional injection band; target active only when current available iGlob>20 W/m2 or lamp command is on, otherwise injection off
controller.heat_vent_rule: native proportional bands with submitted temperature/RH targets; targets are not guaranteed realised states
controller.time_information: Controller uses last available sensor values only, held until next tick. No actual full-day dayRadSum or future measured endpoint. Native lampNoCons/smoothLamp/day classification must be overridden consistently.
controller.first_measurement: sensor event at t=0 before first control update
controller.missing_sensor: hold last available valid measurement; if no measurement exists, pause as infrastructure error, not hidden-state fallback

standby.sensor_rule: latest available air temperature; missing/nonfinite temperature is an infrastructure error
standby.scope: common controller for cleanup and idle; immutable to agent; no active crop policy retained
standby.provenance: development assumptions, not measured operational settings or safety certification
standby.humidity_rule: No independent humidity control while empty; report condensation/climate limitations.

thermal_screen.active_targets: submitted day/night temperature and ventilation RH target
thermal_screen.standby_targets: standby heating target and fixed 87 percent screen RH target
thermal_screen.day_rule: same fixed 06:00-22:00 local standard-time interval as all shared controls
thermal_screen.provenance: Native Katzin screen response constants retained; coupling to submitted targets and standby targets is a disclosed development integration choice, not measured calibration.

budget.physical_caps: Four independent per-compartment equipment maxima and calendar/compartment occupancy; central supply assumed sufficient for simultaneous full output; report realised energy and cost. No additional hidden spending limit.
budget.provenance: explicit benchmark resource assumptions, not measured farming schedules; compute feasibility checked in Phase 1; LLM cost authorization still pending

observations.noise: v0 deterministic virtual sensors, no claim of measured sensor noise; cached immutable records
observations.lai_notice: synthetic sensor proxy, not direct access to all hidden crop states
observations.full: all allowed past records, queried at any current time without advancing physical time
observations.endpoint: operational confirmations and coarse safety flags only while running; normal completion releases final aggregates; early stop releases accrued harvest and consumed-resource totals only, never hidden trajectory or counterfactual yield
observations.stop_release_notice: Endpoint can buy an early endpoint by destroying a crop; stop cost and resource use must be reported

economics.fresh_equivalent_rule: integral(mcFruitHar dt)*1e-6/0.06; standing cFruit is not cumulative harvest
economics.yield_basis: native CH2O-as-dry-matter proxy, following official greenlight_example.py; no marketable-quality model
economics.source: All prices/cost rates are fixed synthetic scenario assumptions, not current market estimates. Dry-matter fraction follows pinned official example.
economics.margin_rule: (fruit_price-handling)*fresh_equivalent - electricity_price*light_kwh - delivered_heat_price*heat_kwh - co2_price*co2_kg - planting - cleanup - background_daily*active_days
economics.water: report integrated positive transpiration separately; do not call it measured irrigation; background service is fixed and no nutrient flux model is claimed

events.completion: At start+180d close crop automatically; charge cleanup, occupy unit for 2d; retain realised harvest only.
events.stop: Immediately cease treatment, pay cleanup, discard standing crop with zero salvage, retain only already harvested output and incurred costs; cleanup occupies 2d.
events.deadline: At day365 stop all still-active crops, settle accrued output/cost and mandatory cleanup fee, record pending cleanup obligation; never simulate future harvest for campaign observations.
events.resource_accounting: area-time includes active crop and cleanup; all crop receipts and costs recorded separately from quality of recommended policy; between-run physical standby energy is recorded at campaign level, cannot be hidden as free energy.
events.safety: Tair<5C or >40C continuously for 3600s triggers crop safety stop; public event only in Endpoint. This is a benchmark safeguard, not a validated crop-death model.
events.numerical_failure: pause infrastructure and preserve identity/log; do not impute poor method performance or silently drop site
events.recommendation: one feasible policy at deadline; fallback to frozen valid initial recommendation if absent or invalid; flag fallback

evaluation.replica_count: Phase3 freeze from numerical precision study

phase1_gates: resolve all controller overrides and derived sensor equations
dynamic temperature/RH/CO2 response and boundary sensitivity
adequate harvest and meaningful adaptive-decision opportunity without selecting sites by method performance
revision_rule: v0 is frozen for implementation, not final study registration. Failure in Phase1 requires an explicit versioned change and reason before pilot/test; never tune on confirmatory outcomes.

supersedes.change: Declare centrally adequate supply and independent per-compartment equipment capacities; no invented cross-compartment bottleneck.
